headline: One run, #9 on arrival: Kaggle’s #2 drops in on ARC-2
dek: tascj, the Kyoto grandmaster ranked second in all of Kaggle, posted a single ARC-2 run. It scored 76.81.

sections.heading: A one-shot debut
sections.text: tascj has made exactly one ARC-2 submission, logged on Saturday evening. Its score, 76.81, reached the public board early on Monday, more than a day later. In places, that run arrived at #9; it is #11 this afternoon. tascj is a Competitions Grandmaster based in Kyoto, Japan, and when we checked on Monday was ranked #2 of 225,007 in Kaggle’s competition rankings.

sections.heading: Franzen’s other front
sections.text: Daniel Franzen, who plays ARC-3 with The ARChitects, plays ARC-2 alone. His score rose from 59.17 to 70.97 since Sunday evening. In places, he went from #47 to #28.

sections.heading: The infinity pair, here as Progress
sections.text: Van-Phuc Huynh and Trần M. Tiến, whose ARC-3 team infinity leapt into the top ten overnight, play ARC-2 as Progress. Their score here rose from 33.47 to 42.50. In places, Progress went from #168 to #93.

sections.heading: Big climbs further down
sections.text: Hack2Publish went from 34.58 to 54.17, the biggest gain in the table. KaggleARC went from 36.94 to 55.14, and AndreasToescher from 34.03 to 45.97. Nearer the top, ibyyue went from 69.17 to 75.14, a climb from #31 to #17.

sections.heading: The top six held
sections.text: The top six places held today. Tufa Labs leads on 88.06, ahead of Yi-Chia Chen on 87.22, nvbanana on 83.89, Domdolus Tolus on 83.47, Sakayori Lab on 81.81 and rabbithole on 80.83. ARC Mutants, the Digest editor’s ARC-2 team, went from 47.08 to 50.83.

sections.heading: Before the bell
sections.text: ARC-2 also closes at 6:59 pm Eastern. tascj’s score took more than a day to reach the public board, so late runs may keep landing after the bell. Medals are decided on the private leaderboard.

discord: Kaggle’s #2 drops in on ARC-2: tascj posted a single run, scored 76.81 and arrived at #9.
